desc: Derive the backward DP state transitions for runs of length 1, 2, and at least 3, including valid character changes and terminal acceptance.
Determine initialization and terminal conditions, especially captions with length less than 3.
Design a memory-efficient implementation suitable for `n <= 5 * 10^4`, including reconstruction storage.
Work out lexicographically smallest reconstruction among all minimum-cost captions using optimal suffix transitions.
Validate the implementation on provided samples and exhaustive small edge cases, including lexicographic ties.
